As Rockwell Collins De (COL) Stock Value Rose, Janney Capital Management Has Increased Holding by $442,800; As Envirostar (EVI) Valuation Rose, Shareholder Bard Associates Has Lowered Its Position by $4.50 Million
May 16, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Janney Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Rockwell Collins Inc De (COL) by 90.56% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Janney Capital Management Llc bought 3,280 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.65% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 6,902 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $936,000, up from 3,622 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Janney Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Rockwell Collins Inc De for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $22.20 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.01% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $135.2. About 1.46 million shares traded or 10.19% up from the average. Rockwell Collins, Inc. (NYSE:COL) has risen 39.79% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 28.24% the S&P500.
Bard Associates Inc decreased its stake in Envirostar Inc (EVI) by 66.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bard Associates Inc sold 112,401 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.87% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 56,700 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.27M, down from 169,101 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bard Associates Inc who had been investing in Envirostar Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $433.90M market cap company. The stock decreased 1.64% or $0.65 during the last trading session, reaching $38.9. About 7,180 shares traded. EnviroStar, Inc. (NYSEMKT:EVI) has risen 101.58% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 90.03% the S&P500.
Janney Capital Management Llc, which manages about $3.30 billion and $2.34 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Spdr Sp Mdcp 400 Etf (MDY) by 1,713 shares to 19,839 shares, valued at $6.85M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Jpmorgan Chase Company (NYSE:JPM) by 49,435 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 225,690 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
